facts.summary: Missed primary endpoint, subgroups numerically better · Phase 2/3 · fosgonimeton in mild-to-moderate Alzheimer's · not yet approved

evidence.summary: LIFT-AD trial did not meet primary endpoint of GST and key secondary endpoints of cognition (ADAS-Cog11) and function (ADCS-ADL23)
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: While the trial did not meet its primary endpoint
evidence.safety: Fosgonimeton was generally well tolerated, with a favorable safety profile.
